purpose: Compile an independent conditional theorem transcription and preserve a complete assumptions receipt without modifying the repository.
theorem_scope: A unit spatial tetrad direction gives a null photon under the explicit (-,+,+,+) quadratic form; this is not a full standard-boost proof.
Static-grid face speed is proportional to R_H under explicit nonzero-width premises.
Positive, negative, and zero upwind branches have the stated one-sided behavior; zero secants agree only when traces agree.
Red, blue, and characteristic event constructors are distinct.
The two-cell remap transcription satisfies conditional number, constant-state, and JVP identities.
Signed distortion, total occupation, packet rate, and deposited occupation rate are separate record types with an explicit deposition seam.
No theorem supplies missing reference bytes, directional incoming data, deposition/remap approval, or external verifier authority.

allowed_mutations: a complete copy of formal/rec_next03/rocq in a disposable directory outside the Git worktree
Makefile.rec-next03 and Rocq build products in that disposable directory
raw build, Print Assumptions, version, hash, and semantic receipts under caller-selected receipt directory
mutation_policy.precondition: Hash every checked-in Rocq input and record git status before copying.
mutation_policy.postcondition: Checked-in Rocq input hashes and git status are unchanged.

scan_semantics: blank nested Rocq block-comment and double-quoted string contents while preserving offsets and line numbers
scan exact Admitted followed by a period and case-insensitive whole-word admit in the remaining code-shaped text
case-insensitive line-anchored scan for singular/plural Parameter, Axiom, and Conjecture after an optional Local/Global prefix
static_rejection.scan_pass_is_not_sufficient: Rocq build and exact 25-theorem Print Assumptions audit are also required

forbidden_assumptions: any assumption declared in RecNext03Contracts.v or All.v
any assumption whose origin cannot be resolved to the required Stdlib module

semantic_projection_fields: Rocq release identity 9.2.0, exact CLI display token, OPAM runtime/core 9.2.0 and rocq-stdlib 9.1.0 installed versions, source hashes, pin fields, switch selector, and canonical prefix
top-level network_isolation with mechanism, executable, probe command/exit_code/stdout_log/stderr_log/timed_out, exact interface list, verified flag, and reason
selected Rocq frontend, executable realpath, exact -where command/stdout, canonical standard-library root, root identity, and module artifact SHA-256
cleared inherited search-path variables and effective runner-controlled paths
exact 25-theorem Print Assumptions output normalized by theorem name
every reported foundation name and resolved Stdlib origin
pass_requirements: Rocq runtime/core release identity 9.2.0 and rocq-stdlib 9.1.0 from their exact unpinned official OPAM sources; CLI display is exactly 9.2 or 9.2.0

the unshare Linux user/network namespace preflight exits zero, records a child namespace inode distinct from the parent, reports exactly loopback through socket.if_nameindex with no non-loopback route, and is recorded as verified
every tool subprocess uses the exact verified namespace prefix; proxy and Git URL rewrite controls alone never satisfy this requirement

documented rocq compile -where or an allowed 9.2 compatibility frontend resolves exactly one absolute captured Stdlib root independent of inherited path overrides; every successful frontend agrees on that canonical root
allowed foundation origins resolve under the captured root and the selected Stdlib module artifact hashes are recorded
no local Parameter, Axiom, Conjecture, Admitted, or admit
exact 25-theorem Print Assumptions audit with only the narrow reported Stdlib foundation allowlist

fail_closed: Do not run any version, Stdlib identity, build, or assumption-audit subprocess unless the unshare Linux user/network namespace preflight verifies a child namespace inode, loopback-only socket.if_nameindex result, and no non-loopback route. An inherited /sys mount is diagnostic only.

Do not treat dead proxy variables, Git URL rewrites, or an inherited /sys/class/net view as proof of network isolation; if unshare is missing, denied, exits nonzero, retains the parent namespace, exposes a non-loopback socket interface, or has a non-loopback route, return ENVIRONMENT_GAP_NETWORK_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE_NOT_PASS before tool execution.
Do not inherit any language, package, cache, or userbase override listed in execution.environment_policy.clear_inherited; only captured runner-controlled paths are permitted.
Do not invoke or accept an undocumented bare where subcommand; Stdlib discovery must use the documented -where option through an allowed frontend.

Do not normalize an arbitrary 9.2 display into release 9.2.0; require live read-only OPAM runtime/core 9.2.0 plus rocq-stdlib 9.1.0, each exact official source hash and empty pin identity, frontend ownership, and a Stdlib root under the same captured prefix.
Do not report PASS if the Rocq 9.2 Stdlib root, executable identity, selected module hashes, or allowed foundation origins are missing, overridden, or unresolved.
Do not report PASS when any expected Print Assumptions theorem is missing, duplicated, or accompanied by an unallowlisted or unresolved foundation.
Do not add Admitted, Axiom, or weaken a statement to obtain a build.
Do not infer a physical adapter from constructor inequality.
Do not infer source bytes, implementation parity, production admission, or a scientific pass from theorem compilation.
Do not modify checked-in Rocq sources during evidence-producing execution.
